description: Deep-research evals for Contextro. Covers triggering, repository grounding, fact/inference/hypothesis separation, negative evidence, and production of measurable top experiments.

benchmark_commands.bench: cd crates && cargo run --release -p contextro --bin contextro-bench -- <repo-path>
benchmark_commands.study: cd crates && cargo run --release -p contextro --bin contextro-study -- --codebase <repo-path> --output-dir <dir> --tasks 200
benchmark_commands.indexing: cd crates && cargo test --quiet -p contextro-indexing --test bench_index -- --nocapture

evals.name: trigger-breakthrough-agenda
evals.prompt: Research deeply how Contextro can beat its retained study token baseline and rank the most promising breakthrough experiments before we touch code.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads, starts from repository evidence, and returns a ranked experiment agenda rather than jumping straight to implementation.

evals.name: trigger-compare-best-in-class
evals.prompt: Compare OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, Windsurf, and Sourcegraph-style mechanisms for low-token code retrieval, but only keep the parts that transfer cleanly to Contextro.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads, translates external ideas into mechanisms, and labels what should be adopted, adapted, or avoided for Contextro.

evals.name: repo-grounding-first
evals.prompt: Why is our search fast but still too token-heavy? Research it before we try another rewrite.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads and begins with current Contextro architecture, retained study numbers, and real benchmark commands before citing outside systems.

evals.name: fact-inference-hypothesis-split
evals.prompt: Give me a breakthrough research brief on improving repo scope and restore workflows in Contextro.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill loads and clearly separates facts, inferences, and hypotheses, then ends with measurable experiments.

evals.name: non-trigger-autonomous-loop
evals.prompt: Keep trying changes until Contextro beats 25ms cold index time.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill does not load because this is an autonomous experiment loop, which belongs to autoresearch.

evals.name: non-trigger-hardening
evals.prompt: Take this promising benchmark win and add rollout, guardrails, and observability.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill does not load because the next step is hardening and shipping, which belongs to applied-ai-engineer.
